exposure: Public health insurance status (vs. private insurance)
outcome: Hemoglobin A1C less than 6% at onset of pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant women with pregestational type 1 or type 2 diabetes who delivered after 24 weeks of gestation and received multidisciplinary endocrinology and obstetric care in Massachusetts between 2006 and 2011.
finding: Publicly insured women with pregestational diabetes were significantly less likely to receive preconception consultation compared to privately insured women, even after adjusting for educational attainment, maternal age, and body mass index.
